lines.text: [curious] Your competitors are running ads right now. Have you seen them?
On Ryze, tracking one takes a second. Type the domain... and that's it.
From now on, Ryze watches their ads for you. Day and night.
The moment they launch something new — you get a notification.
Every ad they run lands in your library. Filter by industry, by platform... or see what's been running for months. Those are their winners.
[warm] Found one you like? Ask the agent to make it yours.
Their best ads... are your starting point.
